hunks.baseline: The fist struck him squarely in the middle of the face, and the Dongting Fisherman’s entire body jerked. From his perspective, it must have felt like being hit with an iron club.
hunks.sol: My fist struck him square in the face, and the Dongting Fisherman’s entire body jerked. To him, it must have felt like being hit with an iron club.

hunks.baseline: His pitch-black pupils trembled, and yellow teeth soaked in blood came tumbling from his gaping mouth.
hunks.sol: His pitch-black pupils trembled. Blood-soaked yellow teeth tumbled from his gaping mouth.

hunks.baseline: The Dongting Fisherman, blood pouring from his mouth and nose like a waterfall, staggered and waved his hand.
hunks.sol: Blood poured from the Dongting Fisherman’s mouth and nose like a waterfall. He staggered and flicked his hand.

hunks.baseline: It was a small movement, but my sharp senses took in everything happening around me with perfect clarity.
hunks.sol: It was only a small movement, but my sharpened senses took in everything happening around me with perfect clarity.

hunks.baseline: Something sliced through the air with a faint yet sharp sound, aiming for my back.
hunks.sol: Something sliced faintly but sharply through the air, aiming for my back.

hunks.baseline: Instead of dodging, I twisted the wrist of the Dongting Fisherman’s hand gripping the black-wood fishing rod.
hunks.sol: Instead of dodging, I twisted the wrist of the hand gripping the Dongting Fisherman’s black-wood fishing rod.

hunks.baseline: His bones broke, and the hand that had lost its strength let the black-wood fishing rod slip free. At the same time, the Force-infused Heavenly Silkworm Thread fluttered through the air.
hunks.sol: His bones broke. The black-wood fishing rod slipped from his powerless grasp, and the Force-infused Heavenly Silkworm Thread fluttered limply through the air.

hunks.baseline: “Where do you get off pulling that bullshit, you son of a bitch? Who do you think you’re fooling?”

hunks.baseline: The answer that came back was a heavy sound splitting the air.
hunks.sol: His answer was a heavy rush of displaced air.

hunks.baseline: The Dongting Fisherman’s palm strike shot toward me with terrifying momentum. But I had already prepared for it, so I reached out to meet it without hesitation.
hunks.sol: The Dongting Fisherman’s palm strike shot toward me with terrifying momentum. But I was already prepared. Without hesitation, I thrust out my own palm to meet it.

hunks.baseline: A swift, concise move of the Flame Divine Palm.
hunks.sol: The swift, concise first form of the Flame Divine Palm.

hunks.baseline: Two Forces—one white and one blue—collided in midair, and razor-sharp winds whipped around us.
hunks.sol: Two Forces—one white, one blue—collided in midair, sending razor-sharp winds whipping around us.

hunks.baseline: Through my wildly fluttering hair, I stared at the Dongting Fisherman with cold eyes.
hunks.sol: Through my wildly tossing hair, I stared coldly at the Dongting Fisherman.

hunks.baseline: I did not need an answer.
hunks.sol: I didn’t need an answer.

hunks.baseline: I already knew what I had to do, and the tip of my foot was already lashing out at the Dongting Fisherman’s knee with lightning speed.
hunks.sol: I already knew what I had to do, and my foot was already lashing out at the Dongting Fisherman’s knee with lightning speed.

hunks.baseline: His bones crunched. His body staggered, and blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
hunks.sol: Bone crunched. His body buckled, and blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.

hunks.baseline: The heavy impact momentarily disrupted the flow of his internal energy, and the Palm Force gathered in the palm still pressed against mine began to fade.
hunks.sol: The heavy impact momentarily disrupted the flow of his internal energy. The Palm Force gathered in the hand still pressed against mine began to fade.

hunks.baseline: The scales of power had already tipped in my favor. I laced my fingers tightly between his and twisted with all my strength.
hunks.sol: The scales had already tipped in my favor. I laced my fingers tightly through his, then twisted with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: Sibu-leol. I had never even held a woman’s hand in my life, yet here in Murim, I had interlocked fingers with enough men to fill a truck.
hunks.sol: Sibu-leol. I’d never even held a woman’s hand in my life, yet here in Murim, I’d interlocked fingers with enough men to fill a truck.

hunks.baseline: Of course, since it was an affectionate finger-lock fueled by the pent-up rage of a lifelong virgin, it was always effective.
hunks.sol: Of course, an affectionate finger-lock fueled by the pent-up rage of a lifelong virgin never failed to deliver.

hunks.baseline: A scream of pain burst from the Dongting Fisherman’s mouth, which had been silent until now.
hunks.sol: A scream of agony finally burst from the Dongting Fisherman’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: I clenched my fist and punched him again and again as he stared at me with his pitch-black eyes wide open.
hunks.sol: As he glared at me through pitch-black eyes, I hammered him with punch after punch.

hunks.baseline: Under the unceasing rain of fists and palms, the Dongting Fisherman’s movements slowly weakened.
hunks.sol: Under the relentless barrage of fists and palms, the Dongting Fisherman’s resistance slowly weakened.

hunks.baseline: Why?
hunks.sol: What was it?

hunks.baseline: Carelessness, born from thinking I had completely secured the advantage? Confidence that I could capture him without killing him?
hunks.sol: Had I let my guard down because I thought victory was assured? Had I grown too confident that I could capture him alive?

hunks.baseline: Whatever the reason, I had failed to be thorough, and that created an opening.
hunks.sol: Whatever the reason, I hadn’t been thorough.
And that created an opening.

hunks.baseline: My vision turned completely red.
hunks.sol: My vision turned red.

hunks.baseline: The sticky blood the Dongting Fisherman vomited drenched my face and froze my body for an instant.
hunks.sol: The Dongting Fisherman’s sticky blood drenched my face, making me freeze for an instant.

hunks.baseline: And the counterattack of a Supreme Peak master fighting for his life was fiercer than I had expected.
hunks.sol: And the counterattack of a Supreme Peak master fighting for his life was fiercer than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: With a sound like compressed air exploding, a stream of internal energy flowed through the surface of the Fire Dragon Armor as though it had passed straight through it, then battered my upper body.
hunks.sol: With a sound like compressed air exploding, a stream of internal energy seemed to pass straight through the surface of the Fire Dragon Armor and slammed into my upper body.

hunks.baseline: As the scenery flashed past me, one thought crossed my mind.
hunks.sol: As the scenery flashed past, a thought crossed my mind.

hunks.baseline: I had taken an unexpected blow, but compared to the Dongting Fisherman’s condition, this was nothing.
hunks.sol: I’d taken an unexpected blow, but compared to the Dongting Fisherman’s condition, this was nothing.

hunks.baseline: That I had suffered only a minor internal injury despite being caught off guard by the Inner-Family Heavy Hand was proof enough.
hunks.sol: The fact that an unexpected Inner-Family Heavy Hand had left me with only a minor internal injury was proof enough.

hunks.baseline: I sent my internal energy, its flow interrupted for only an instant, coursing through every limb and acupoint in my body.
hunks.sol: I sent the flow of internal energy, interrupted for only an instant, coursing through every limb and acupoint in my body.

hunks.baseline: The acupoints damaged by the Inner-Family Heavy Hand complained of a little pain, but that was all.
hunks.sol: The acupoints damaged by the Inner-Family Heavy Hand throbbed slightly, but that was all.

hunks.baseline: Just as a carp in a pond does not die because someone scoops out a bowlful of water, I was fine as well.
hunks.sol: A carp didn’t die just because someone scooped a bowlful of water from its pond.
Neither would I.

hunks.baseline: I twisted my body around in midair as I shot forward. The opposite cave wall rushed toward me, so I gently planted my foot against it, then detonated the internal energy that had flowed into my toes.
hunks.sol: I twisted around in midair while hurtling backward. The opposite wall of the cave rushed toward me. I planted my foot against it lightly, then detonated the internal energy flowing through my toes.

hunks.baseline: With a roar like the sky splitting apart, the unyielding rocks in the wall exploded.
hunks.sol: With a roar like the sky splitting apart, the rock of the unyielding wall exploded.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds—thousands—of fragments tore through every direction, but I was already gone.
hunks.sol: Hundreds—thousands—of fragments tore through the air in every direction, but I was already gone.

hunks.baseline: Heavier than a rock, faster than the wind.
hunks.sol: Heavier than a boulder. Faster than the wind.

hunks.baseline: My body tore through the air several times faster than when I had been thrown back, carrying the weight of ten thousand *geun*.
hunks.sol: My entire body cleaved through the air several times faster than when I’d been thrown back, carrying the weight of ten thousand *geun*.

hunks.baseline: My shout reverberated through the vast cavern. Several *jiazi* of Scorching Yang Qi infused in my voice crushed the water and pushed the rocks aside.
hunks.sol: My shout shook the vast cavern. Several *jiazi* of Scorching Yang Qi carried within my voice pressed down the water and forced the rocks aside.

hunks.baseline: And at the end of it all, there was one person.
hunks.sol: And at the end of it all stood one man.

hunks.baseline: The Dongting Fisherman had just pulled White Flame out of his shoulder and the rock wall behind him when he spotted me and opened his eyes wide.
hunks.sol: The Dongting Fisherman had just pulled White Flame from his shoulder and the rock wall behind him when he spotted me. His eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: His blackened pupils shook, and a glimpse of white flashed across them.
hunks.sol: His blackened pupils trembled, flashing a sliver of white.

hunks.baseline: His trembling mouth opened, and his one remaining front tooth quivered pitifully.
hunks.sol: His mouth quivered open, and his one remaining front tooth trembled pitifully.

hunks.baseline: “C-c-c-come…”
hunks.sol: “D-d-d-don’t…”

hunks.baseline: Don’t come, you mean?
hunks.sol: Don’t come any closer?

hunks.baseline: I had no idea why the man who had been acting like a madman only moments ago was trembling like that, but my mind was already made up.
hunks.sol: I had no idea why the man who’d been acting like a lunatic only moments ago was suddenly trembling like that, but my mind was already made up.

hunks.baseline: *I was planning to take you back in one piece if possible…… but that’s not going to happen.*
hunks.sol: *I was going to bring you back in one piece if possible… but that’s not happening now.*

hunks.baseline: Regret would be useless now. The Dongting Fisherman should have regretted his actions long ago.
hunks.sol: It was too late for regret. The Dongting Fisherman should have regretted his actions long ago.

hunks.baseline: Before taking Dark Heaven’s hand. Before brutally slaughtering innocent commoners and children. He should have regretted it and repented then.
hunks.sol: Before joining hands with Dark Heaven. Before brutally slaughtering innocent commoners and children.
That was when he should have regretted his actions and repented.

hunks.baseline: Now that we had come this far, repentance was unnecessary.
hunks.sol: Now that we’d come this far, there was no need for repentance.

hunks.baseline: All that remained was punishment for the crimes he had committed.
hunks.sol: All that remained was punishment for his crimes.

hunks.baseline: I did not care if I crushed all four of his limbs. As long as he was still breathing, I could pull out every last strand of his hair and tooth, then drive a stalactite into his ass.
hunks.sol: I didn’t care if I crushed all four of his limbs. As long as he kept breathing, I could tear out every last strand of hair and every tooth, then drive a stalactite up his ass.

hunks.baseline: I would take his life only after he had spat out everything he knew about Dark Heaven.
hunks.sol: I would take his life only after he’d spat out everything he knew about Dark Heaven.

hunks.baseline: I would keep him alive by the barest margin.
hunks.sol: I’d leave him just alive enough to breathe.

hunks.baseline: Only until my anger at what he had done had diminished, even slightly.
hunks.sol: And beat him just enough to ease my anger at what he’d done, if only a little.

hunks.baseline: With exactly that much force, I shot toward him. In the slowed world, I extended my fist.
hunks.sol: With exactly that much force behind me, I shot toward him and extended my fist through the slowed world.

hunks.baseline: The fiercely burning blue-white hellfire swallowed the palm strike the Dongting Fisherman thrust at me, even with his broken hand.
hunks.sol: Fiercely blazing blue-white hellfire swallowed the palm strike the Dongting Fisherman thrust out with his broken hand.

hunks.baseline: His Palm Force, now murky like muddy water, shattered and evaporated under the power of the Scorching Yang Qi. Beyond the endless whirlwind of wind and flashes of light, my fist wreathed in flame broke through the Body-Protecting Qi surrounding the Dongting Fisherman.
hunks.sol: His Palm Force, now as murky as muddy water, shattered and evaporated beneath the Scorching Yang Qi. Beyond the ceaseless whirlwind and flashes of light, my flame-wreathed fist smashed through the Body-Protecting Qi surrounding him.

hunks.baseline: *What the…… Ah.*
hunks.sol: *What the… Ah.*

hunks.baseline: Even if someone was a master of water arts, that only applied when they had enough internal energy and consciousness to operate those techniques.
hunks.sol: Even a master of water arts needed enough internal energy and awareness to use those techniques.

hunks.baseline: He did not have gills like I did. If he stayed underwater for too long, he might die.
hunks.sol: He didn’t breathe through gills like I did. If he remained underwater too long, he might die.

hunks.baseline: *Wait. If that’s the case……*
hunks.sol: *Wait. If that’s the case…*

hunks.baseline: A flash of insight crossed my mind.
hunks.sol: A flash of insight struck me.

hunks.baseline: I might have been willing to donate an interlocked-finger clasp, but I could not give up my first kiss as well.

hunks.baseline: Especially not to a crazy old man who was nearly a hundred years old!
hunks.sol: Especially not to a crazy old man who was nearly a hundred!

hunks.sol: The vibrations that began somewhere deep beneath the water were powerful enough to reach the people on the surface.

hunks.baseline: At the sudden anomaly, the old boatman shrank into himself with fear in his eyes, while the other three men’s faces stiffened.
hunks.sol: At the sudden disturbance, the old boatman hunched over in fear. The other three men’s faces stiffened.

hunks.baseline: “Um, I think…….”
hunks.sol: “Um, I think…”

hunks.baseline: “It seems it has finally begun. Or perhaps it has already ended.”
hunks.sol: “It seems it’s finally begun. Or perhaps it has already ended.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang answered Cheongpung’s murmur in a heavy voice.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang answered Cheongpung’s murmur in a grave voice.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin, who had been anxiously watching the trembling cliff and river, suddenly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin, who had been anxiously watching the trembling cliff and river, abruptly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “It’s certain that something happened to our Captain. I have a bad feeling.”
hunks.sol: “Something must have happened to the Captain. I have a bad feeling.”

hunks.baseline: “But Jin Taekyung, that bastard…….”
hunks.sol: “But Jin Taekyung, that bastard…”

hunks.baseline: “He told us not to move and wait. I know.”
hunks.sol: “He told us not to move and to wait here. I know.”

hunks.baseline: “I have a terrible habit of not listening to people.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve always been terrible at listening to people.”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t it better than sitting here sucking our fingers?”
hunks.sol: “Isn’t it better than sitting here doing nothing?”

hunks.baseline: At Hyuk Mujin’s words, Gung Gibang bit his lower lip.
hunks.sol: At Hyuk Mujin’s words, Gung Gibang gnawed at his lower lip.

hunks.baseline: He had been feeling uneasy for some time as well.
hunks.sol: He, too, had been uneasy for some time.

hunks.baseline: He did not know exactly when it had begun, but his heart was pounding violently, and every one of his senses was on edge.
hunks.sol: He didn’t know exactly when it had begun, but his heart was pounding violently, and every one of his senses was on edge.

hunks.baseline: *Why am I like this? Did something really happen to that bastard?*
hunks.sol: *What’s wrong with me? Did something really happen to that bastard?*

hunks.baseline: A single face flashed before his eyes.
hunks.sol: A face flashed before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: The kind of bastard who would come back alive even if you dropped him into the deepest pit of the underworld. More vicious than A-Gwi, and strong enough to beat Yama himself into the ground.
hunks.sol: The kind of bastard who looked capable of crawling back alive even if he were thrown into the deepest pit of the underworld. More vicious than A-Gwi and strong enough to beat Yama himself into the ground.

hunks.baseline: *I’ve never once imagined that bastard dying…… No, nothing is absolute, so surely not?*
hunks.sol: *I’ve never once imagined that bastard dying… But nothing is absolute. Surely not?*

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang had not taken Jin Taekyung’s words before he entered the river lightly. By now, after traveling with him for so long, he knew that there was always a reason behind the man’s words and actions.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang hadn’t dismissed what Jin Taekyung had said before entering the river. After traveling with him for so long, he knew there was always a reason behind the man’s words and actions.

hunks.baseline: But this time, he could not help wavering.
hunks.sol: But this time, he couldn’t help wavering.

hunks.baseline: *Goddammit. The weather’s a complete mess, too. What the hell am I supposed to do?*
hunks.sol: *Goddammit. The weather’s gone completely to shit too. What the hell am I supposed to do?*

hunks.baseline: Just as the old boatman had said a couple of *shichen* earlier, even calling the current weather on Dongting Lake the worst possible would have been an understatement.
hunks.sol: Just as the old boatman had warned a couple of *shichen* earlier, even calling the current weather on Dongting Lake the worst imaginable would have been an understatement.

hunks.baseline: A raging storm and lightning crashing down from the sky.
hunks.sol: A raging storm. Lightning crashing down from the sky.

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang looked around with a conflicted expression and finally opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang looked around with conflicted eyes and finally opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: Or rather, he was just about to open it when—
hunks.sol: Or rather, he was just about to when—

hunks.baseline: Someone was smiling brightly in their field of view.
hunks.sol: Someone was smiling brightly at them.

hunks.baseline: At the edge of the small island where they stood, Cheongpung had been lying face-down, listening to something. He brushed the sand from his ear and grinned.
hunks.sol: At the edge of the small island where they stood, Cheongpung had been lying facedown, listening to something. He brushed the sand from his ear and grinned.

hunks.baseline: A person shot up with a towering column of water and landed roughly on the sandy shore.
hunks.sol: A figure shot from the water atop a towering spray and landed heavily on the sandy shore.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t come near me, you dickheads. If any of you is trying to hug me, all three of you are getting killed today.”
hunks.sol: “Stay back, you dickheads. If any of you tries to hug me, all three of you are getting murdered today.”

hunks.baseline: After stopping the three men charging toward him with cries of joy, Jin Taekyung continued in a serious tone.
hunks.sol: After stopping the three men charging toward him with cries of joy, Jin Taekyung continued in a grave voice.

hunks.baseline: “We don’t have time, so I’ll ask directly. Raise your hand if you’ve ever kissed someone. Or if you want to try. Hands up.”
hunks.sol: “We don’t have time, so I’ll get straight to the point. Raise your hand if you’ve ever kissed someone. Or if you want to try it. Hands up.”

hunks.baseline: As Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin quietly backed away, one hand shot into the air with a bright, innocent shout.
hunks.sol: As Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin quietly backed away, one hand shot into the air amid a bright, innocent shout.

hunks.baseline: “Me! Me! I haven’t kissed anyone even once!”
hunks.sol: “Me! Me! I’ve never kissed anyone before!”

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. Thank God.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. Thank you, God.”

hunks.baseline: With a radiant smile on his face, Jin Taekyung held the Dongting Fisherman out toward the bewildered Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: Beaming from ear to ear, Jin Taekyung held the Dongting Fisherman out toward the bewildered Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: “Your wish has just come true.”
hunks.sol: “Your wish just came true.”

hunks.baseline: Thunder and lightning shook the entire world.
hunks.sol: Thunder and lightning shook the world.
